|game_text=Deploy on table. At Endor sites where you have an Ewok, your characters are forfeit and defense value +1 (+3 if you have two Ewoks at that site.) In battles at Endor sites where all your ability is provided by Ewoks, add one battle destiny. (Immune to Alter.)
|joke=The lore is an Ewok line with no translation and a sixteen-o "noooooooooooooooowa". The picture is the Ewok party at the end of ''Return of the Jedi'', whose song, "Ewok Celebration" or "Yub Nub", has Ewokese words by Ben Burtt and published English words; the card's line is not in them, and the 1997 Special Edition replaced the song with "Victory Celebration".<ref name="wook-ewokcelebration">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ewok_Celebration Ewok Celebration], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260306040452/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ewok_Celebration Internet Archive], 6 March 2026.</ref> It is part of the running gag of cards that print alien speech and sounds without a translation. See [[Jokes#Alien speech and sounds|Jokes]].
